# The shapes the check leaves alone

A document that discusses a footnote must be able to quote a marker. Write
`[^7]` to name the token rather than follow it.[^1]

A fenced block holds the same:

```markdown
[^99]: A footnote in an example. `docs/nowhere.md`
```

A gap in the numbering is not a failure, so this document goes from one to
three.[^3]

## References

[^1]: Documentation Rules, section 3. `.claude/rules/documentation.md`
[^3]: Documentation Rules, section 4. `.claude/rules/documentation.md`
